comparison.objective: Transfer an electrode roll using a spindle passed through its core and deposit the spindle ends on rests.
comparison.physical_skill: Through-core insertion, suspended load carrying, and two-end placement.
comparison.success_condition: Roll carried only by the spindle, both spindle ends supported, released, stable, and without excessive sag.
comparison.reason: Although both involve alignment and transfer, this record supports and carries a roll on an inserted tool; it does not bridge two guide surfaces or preserve loose circulating elements during a carriage transfer.
